proof_artifacts.notes: Mojo proof_partial is a Debian feasibility spike plus Shared script corpus proof and local Reference proof surface: pinned Mojo 1.0.0b1 install, Project-shaped status, libsecp256k1 vectors, RocksDB runtime proof, native-boundary audit, Docker 45/45 script corpus, Docker/local-reference 5k proof command, and Docker/local-reference 50k proof command. Native libsecp256k1 remains the comparable crypto lane; docker-script-corpus-shadow is diagnostic-only Zig-style comparator output that writes Mojo-local port.script_corpus_shadow_crypto.v1 output and must not be imported as canonical corpus evidence. The pure Mojo backend currently supports BIP340 Schnorr and Taproot tweak primitives through libsecp-guided fixed-limb field multiplication and Jacobian group operations, leaves ECDSA unsupported, and enables only the bounded scripts.p2tr_tapscript_numequal_32712 and scripts.p2tr_scriptpath_44295 corpus shadow rows until runtime evidence justifies broader Taproot shadow coverage. Proof paths collect a deterministic block-level script job/result batch; defaults execute sequentially, while MOJOBITNODE_PAR_SCRIPT_VERIFY=1 enables a diagnostic Mojo parallelize runner only when a block has enough script jobs. Proof paths reuse a Mojo-owned native crypto wrapper for long script job batches; native crypto call counts remain in telemetry, while per-call crypto timing is profiling-only via MOJOBITNODE_PROFILE_CRYPTO=1. UTXO deletes, unspent creates, undo, block storage, and metadata are staged into one RocksDB batch commit after verification passes. The debug storage path opens RocksDB with the durable fast-port tuning profile, loads distinct external block prevouts through ordered multi_get, uses Mojo-owned sorted outpoint indexes for block-local lookup, and selects BIP143/Taproot sighash precompute by spent-script family. Generic packed RocksDB batch apply is available for diagnostic profiling with MOJOBITNODE_PACKED_ROCKSDB_BATCH=1, but default proof commits keep the proven WriteBatch primitive path because packed encoding regressed 50k wall time. Project control artifacts remain the source of accepted benchmark truth.

known_caveats: Debian bookworm is mandatory for the spike; Ubuntu fallback is intentionally disallowed.
The spike binary owns offline corpus and local Reference 5k/50k proof paths; parallel script verification is diagnostic and env-enabled until Project promotion is explicitly rerun.
Binary gate, external peers, 10k, 100k, supervisor, and tip lanes are not attempted.
